firmware.name: Audrey II Touch
firmware.author: Synthux Academy
firmware.description: A horrorscape feedback synthesizer after Audrey II by Infrasonic Audio. Pads excite the loop; external audio can drive it too.
firmware.notes:
## Audrey II Touch
Source: [Synthux-Academy/AudreyTouch](https://github.com/Synthux-Academy/AudreyTouch). Careful with volume: start with every knob counter-clockwise and slowly bring up S30 and S31.

## Pads
- **P03–P09** · excite the loop at different frequencies
- **P00 / P02** · octave down / up
- **P11 + P00** · cycle the three pad scales
- **P11 + P02** · drone on / off
- **P11 + S37** · envelope shape
- **P10 + S31** · output volume

## Switches
- **S09-S10** · unused
- **S07-S08** · modulation of the right fader: up fast random, centre slow random, down off (S37 sets the body directly)

Audio in uses the left channel only.

## MIDI CC
| CC | Parameter |
|---|---|
| 7 | output volume |
| 12 | reverb decay |
| 70 | frequency |
| 72 | envelope shape |
| 74 | low pass cutoff |
| 75 | feedback gain |
| 76 | feedback body |
| 77 | input volume |
| 81 | high pass cutoff |
| 91 | reverb mix |
